hooks.command: result=$(slopwatch analyze -d . --output json --fail-on error 2>/dev/null); if echo "$result" | grep -q '"errors": [1-9]'; then echo "SLOPWATCH BLOCKED: Your edit introduced code that violates slopwatch rules. Review the errors below and fix them before proceeding:" >&2; echo "$result" | jq -r '.results[] | "- \(.filePath):\(.lineNumber) [\(.ruleId)]: \(.message)\n  Fix: \(.suggestedFix)"' >&2; exit 2; fi
